children: Sysco completed a 12,345,679-share public offering at $81.00 per share, generating approximately $967.4 million in net proceeds to help fund its pending acquisition of JRD Unico and related costs.
Offered 12,345,679 shares of common stock at $81.00 per share; offering closed Sept. 16, 2026.
Underwriters received a 30-day option to buy up to 1,851,851 additional shares to cover any overallotments.
Net proceeds of ~ $967.4 million expected to be used to pay a portion of cash consideration for the JRD Unico acquisition and related fees and expenses.
Offering conducted under Form S-3 registration; underwriting agreement includes customary terms, representations and indemnities.
